description: Signals to the agent-orchestration Worker's POST /routine-signal (AGENT_OUTCOMES_ENDPOINT, bearer AGENT_OUTCOMES_TOKEN), shared by every loop, in a session the Worker fired (its first prompt carries route=… repo=… number=…). PostToolUse: a heartbeat naming the step, at most once a minute. Notification (a permission prompt): blocked. SessionEnd: ended, when the session reported no outcome. Outcomes themselves go through skills/agent-outcomes/scripts/post-outcome.sh, never inferred from a tool call. See docs/agent-orchestration/11-outcome-artifact.md in umbraco-mcp-ops.
